name: devstral-small-2-24b
about: Mistral AI Devstral Small 2 24B Instruct (2512), a coding model, FP8 as published (the only release). Apache-2.0, EU vendor. On the A100 its FP8 runs without hardware support: Ministral 3's FP8 failed to compile on an A40, so start with a fast run. Settings every Mistral 3 model needed: vLLM v0.29.0, Mistral's own format, reasoning_effort none.
